## Accepted finite-subgroup-colimit partial, attempt 1/5

Problem 11000298 / AMR-109-0298, rank 1257. The target concerns finite actual-subgroup inclusion diagrams for Out(F_n), n >= 2, and extended closed-unmarked-surface mapping class groups Mod±(S_g), g >= 1, with canonical colimit map an isomorphism.

The complete report and audit preserve the credited GL(2,Z) endpoint and full presentation with R^2=1; the all-rank W_n/H_n/C_n actual outer intersections and infinite-order eight-syllable kernel; the corrected subordinate-diagram retraction and extra-arrow condition for equality of colimits; the rational H^2 necessity and torsion-free trivial-coefficient generalization; explicit Z^2 dimension-one obstructions; and the C2*C3 counterexample to the all-finite-subgroups reduction. All symbolic proofs, source hypotheses, credited prior inputs and authored mathematical examples remain included.

General finite higher-dimensional diagrams in the higher-rank/higher-genus cases remain unresolved. The cohomology obstruction is not activated for these targets; failure of one support-restricted family does not exclude genuinely different finite subgroups. No novelty certification is claimed.

Programs, computational sections/results, fixtures, imported dataset contents, copied third-party source bodies and private coordination material are excluded. No excluded computation is rewritten as prose.

This AI-assisted, unrefereed edition claims no historical novelty, priority, current-openness certification, external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Recorded source retrieval and inspection are historical observations. Edition preparation claims no new scholarly retrieval, PDF rehash, source inspection or literature search.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries remain unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
